message.content:
Here’s a quick list of well‑rated Thai spots in Chicago that offer solid vegetarian selections: | Restaurant | Location (Neighborhood) | Vegetarian Highlights | |------------|------------------------|-----------------------| | **Siam** | West Loop – 111 W Washington St | • *Vegetarian Pad Krapow* (stir‑fried basil w/ tofu)
• *Tom Yum Soup* (vegetable broth, mushrooms, lemongrass)
• *Green Curry* (tofu & mixed veggies) | | **Baan Thai** | River North – 1400 N Clark St | • *Massaman Tofu Stew*
• *Pad See Ew* (no meat version available upon request)
• *Coconut Rice* served separately so you control toppings | | **Mango Tree Bistro** | Lincoln Park – 4001 N Broadway | • *Veggie Spring Rolls* (served fresh, not fried)
• *Red Curry* (with extra vegetables, optional tofu)
• *Papaya Salad* (vegan if you skip peanuts) | | **Tamarind House** | South Side – 1209 S State St | • *Vegetarian Tom Kha Gai* (use coconut milk + veggie stock)
• *Stir‑Fried Mixed Veggies* (available without chicken)
• *Rice Pilaf* (plain rice base, add your own veggies) | ### Quick Tips When Ordering: 1. **Ask for “No Meat” or “Vegan” versions:** Most places will happily swap out meats for tofu or simply leave them off. 2. **Check for hidden animal products:** Some sauces contain fish sauce or shrimp paste—ask for alternatives when possible. 3. **Use the “rice” option first:** Order plain jasmine or sticky rice and then ask for separate sides so you only take what fits your diet. If you’d like more detailed menus or phone numbers, let me know!
